title: The Perfect day for the harvest
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：perfect　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 perfect 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the father wrote of ① a perfect day for the harvest in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② so perfect that nobody in the house would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the perfect ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the perfect day for the harvest that anybody there had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too perfect to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the perfect ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a perfect silence in the hall, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as perfect as the silence in the hall they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was perfect or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something perfect, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite perfect; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the perfect ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another perfect day for the harvest in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less perfect than anybody had expected. ⑩ The perfect silence in the hall that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the perfect ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 完美（前置定语 a perfect day for the harvest：1985 年父亲在家书里记下的那件完美的绝佳天气）
B. adj. 完美／完全（两处加强说法：so perfect that … 与 no less perfect than …）
C. adj. 完美／完全（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 完美（表语 too perfect to do：母亲觉得它太完美，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 完全（前置定语 a perfect silence in the hall：叔叔把整件事称作一桩完全的一片死寂）
F. adj. 完全（同级比较 as perfect as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厅里的一片死寂相比）
G. adj. 完全（后置定语 something perfect：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 完全（受程度副词修饰 quite perfect：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: a perfect day for the harvest
the perfect day for the harvest that
a perfect silence in the hall
The perfect silence in the hall that

answers.why: perfect 意为“完美”，1985 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件完美的绝佳天气”，此处作前置定语 a perfect day for the harvest。
perfect 意为“完美”，此处用 so perfect that 结构，说它完美到老屋里没人敢靠近。
perfect 意为“完美”，家书上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的完美收割的绝佳天气，等于最高级的说法。
perfect 意为“完美”，母亲认为这件东西“太完美了，谁也用不上”，too perfect to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
perfect 意为“完全”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩完全的一片死寂”，此处作前置定语 a perfect silence in the hall。
perfect 意为“完全”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厅里的一片死寂一样完全”，同级比较用 as perfect as。
perfect 意为“完全”，家书上那半行字要的是“完全的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something perfect。
perfect 意为“完全”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当完全”，quite 修饰原级 perfect。
perfect 意为“完全”，no less perfect than 表示“其完全不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之完全不亚于任何人的预料。
perfect 意为“完全”，母亲 1997 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的完全一片死寂”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件完美的绝佳天气。（a perfect day for the harvest）
它完美到老屋里没有一个人敢靠近。（so perfect that …）
母亲觉得它太完美，谁也用不上。（too perfect to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩完全的一片死寂。（a perfect silence in the hall）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厅里的一片死寂一样完全。（as perfect as …）
到了 1992 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件完全的东西。（something perfect）
answers: In 1985 the father wrote of a perfect day for the harvest in the letter.
It was so perfect that nobody in the house would go near it.
My mother thought it too perfect to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a perfect silence in the hall.
He said nobody would call it as perfect as the silence in the hall they had once had.
By 1992 the letter asked for nothing but something perfect.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 perfect 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the father wrote of a perfect day for the harvest in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the perfect day for the harvest that anybody there had ever seen, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too perfect to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a perfect silence in the hall, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite perfect, and everybody laughed.
The perfect ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
